tasks.approved_by: Founder approval in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-10-30
scope: Investigate failures in configured PadippuPal CI and test workflows.
Prepare focused repairs only when they are necessary to satisfy an already-approved roadmap task's acceptance criteria.
Run the relevant regression checks and create a reviewable pull request.
non_goals: Invent or implement new product features.
Change curriculum or learner-facing behavior outside an approved task.
Merge pull requests, deploy production, write production data, perform destructive migrations, or publish releases.
acceptance_criteria: Every repair links to the originating failed workflow run and exact tested SHA.
A confirmed root cause and regression test are recorded before a repair is proposed.
No more than five distinct repair generations are attempted for one originating failure; generation five failure escalates.
All changes are isolated in branches and submitted as pull requests.
Required checks run against the exact proposed commit and no assertions are weakened or tests skipped.

tasks.approved_by: Founder request in ChatGPT conversation on 2026-11-07 to implement automatic curated web-image ingestion into production DB; merge/deploy approval is conditional on required checks passing.
scope: Implement secure server-side fetching of curator-reviewed direct image URLs for the approved Beyond Earth lesson.
Retain source URL, creator, reuse licence and attribution with image bytes in existing PostgreSQL BYTEA image tables.
Validate allowed source hosts, HTTPS, redirects, public DNS answers, response size, MIME and image signatures.
Validate approved lesson and exact teaching-step mappings; store assets pending review.
Add regression tests and evidence-led PR changes.
Add a fixed, founder-approved NASA Space Place manifest and a Render startup worker so the initial batch fetches automatically without an admin ZIP or API trigger.
Use a PostgreSQL advisory lock and preserve already-reviewed ready assets on idempotent retries.
Disable the existing Gemini auto-generation startup trigger for this Beyond Earth rollout to avoid duplicate generation and Gemini quota use; retain the Gemini admin router.
non_goals: Modify synthesis lesson text or teaching sequence.
Automatically mark unreviewed images ready or learner-visible.
Fetch arbitrary user-supplied hosts or bypass source licensing.
Merge, deploy, or write production data before the conditional release gates pass.
Do not automatically publish pending assets; review each fetched image and approve only after visual/provenance verification.
Do not run automatic Gemini image generation in parallel with the curated NASA web-image rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Backend URL-ingestion route fetches images server-side without ZIP/manual local upload.
SSRF, redirect, size, MIME, licence/provenance and lesson/step validation are covered by tests.
Production deployment and DB ingestion are separately verified before claiming completion.
Learner-facing visibility remains gated by review and is verified only after approval.
The approved manifest is fetched automatically on production startup without a user API call or ZIP upload.
Repeated startup does not downgrade unchanged ready assets.
